features.title: One Host service port for credentials kept in a secrets catalog
features.summary: Name the scopes a catalog can address and the two calls a credential consumer makes, so the provider and the consumer share one definition instead of depending on each other.
failureModes: A scope the catalog cannot address is rejected before any call reaches the catalog.
A consumer reads the port through the Cordis Context and treats a missing provider as unavailable instead of failing.

rejects a scope the catalog cannot address
